featuredWork.title: Xnapper — Product Engineering
featuredWork.description: I helped evolve a commercial screenshot product into a broader image and video editing experience, owning complex features across interface, state, processing, persistence and production delivery.

contributions.title: Video editing pipeline
contributions.body: Built the video editing flow from scratch, including timeline, clips, frame-accurate playback and FFmpeg/WASM export.

contributions.title: Architecture and state
contributions.body: Refactored central export and history flows, using clear abstractions for multiple strategies, undo/redo and cross-runtime persistence.

contributions.title: Reliability and security
contributions.body: Hardened file, process and path handling, reduced attack surface and introduced automated tests for critical flows.

contributions.title: End-to-end product delivery
contributions.body: Worked from UI behavior and application state through processing and release concerns, shipping features in a real review-driven product cycle.
